title: Odd-symmetrized acceptance equals odd-part acceptance
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a randomized sign tester on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $f$ be a function on that cube with values in $[-1,1]$. The acceptance probability of $f$ under the odd-symmetrized tester equals the acceptance probability under $T$ of the odd part $x\mapsto(f(x)-f(-x))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a sign tester on the $n$-cube
$f$ is a bounded cube function valued in $[-1,1]$
